Title: Store greens in a towel-lined container, not a sealed bag
Description: Dry loose greens well, store them in a towel-lined container in the high-humidity crisper, keep the fridge cold, and don't re-wash ready-to-eat bags.
Keywords: food storage, kitchen tips, reduce food waste, produce storage, meal planning

Title: Quiet a popping water heater with a 30–60 minute flush
Description: Popping or rumbling usually means sediment on the bottom of the tank, not a failing water heater. Here's how to flush it safely and when to call a plumber.
Keywords: water heater maintenance, home maintenance, plumbing, appliance repair

Title: Clean the filter first, the top cause of dishwasher smell
Description: A smelly dishwasher usually means trapped food gunk, not a broken machine. Work through this checklist to find the source and clear it for good.

Title: Refreeze fridge-thawed ground meat within 1–2 days
Description: Yes, if it thawed in the fridge and is within 1–2 days (ground meat, poultry) or 3–5 days (steaks, roasts). Past that, or left out over 2 hours, toss it.
Keywords: food safety, food storage, meat handling, kitchen habits, reducing food waste

Title: A worn-clothes hook, emptied weekly, ends the chair pile
Description: Worn-once clothes go on one small 'worn' hook or shelf, or back in the closet once aired out and odor-free. A quick test and a system that ends the chair pile.
Keywords: laundry, decluttering, closet organization, cleaning routines
